review_comments: This means ALL sensors are declared a measurement, but is that correct? Some entities represent totals too right?
I believe they are all measurements.
I dunno, for example, the distance sensor is not measurement IMHO, they are total increasing.
Hmm, I can’t see a distance sensor in my version of the integration.

That is possible, what is shown/exposed depends on what you are actually using.

Ref: <https://github.com/vangorra/python_withings_api/blob/master/withings_api/common.py#L190>

Sorry, but not sure of the relevance of that code.

In the HA integration, the measurement types seems to be from https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/withings/const.py#L18, which does not include distance.
The entities created appear to have to be on on the types in WITHINGS_ATTRIBUTES also defiend in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/withings/common.py#L123, which also does not have distance - and all seem to be measurements.
